name: Big Health (Sleepio, Daylight)
one_liner: Company behind SleepioRx (digital CBT for insomnia) and DaylightRx (digital CBT for anxiety), FDA-cleared apps reached through a prescription or employer.
best_for: Adults with chronic insomnia or generalized anxiety who want structured digital CBT
People whose clinician, health system, employer or health plan offers Sleepio or Daylight
Medicare patients whose clinician can prescribe SleepioRx or DaylightRx
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want to buy it themselves: there is no published self-pay option
People who want a live therapist
short_description: Big Health makes Sleepio/SleepioRx for insomnia and Daylight/DaylightRx for anxiety, available by prescription or through employers and plans.
long_description: Big Health is a digital mental health company that makes two self-guided CBT programs: Sleepio for chronic insomnia and Daylight for generalized anxiety. The prescription versions, SleepioRx and DaylightRx, received FDA 510(k) clearance in 2024 and can be ordered by a licensed clinician; Medicare billing codes for digital mental health treatment devices took effect in January 2025. The non-prescription versions are offered through some employers and health plans. Both programs have randomized trials behind them, mostly funded by Big Health. The company raised $23.7 million in February 2026. This profile covers the company; see the separate Sleepio and Daylight profiles for each program.
patient_summary: Big Health makes Sleepio, a digital CBT program for insomnia, and Daylight, a digital CBT program for anxiety. You get them either through a clinician's prescription (SleepioRx, DaylightRx) or free through an employer or health plan that offers them. There is no published self-pay price.

pricing.starting_price: Free through some employers; copay with insurance or Medicare by prescription
pricing.notes: No self-pay price published. Medicare codes since January 2025; commercial coverage varies by plan.

privacy.notes: Big Health privacy notice (read 2026-10-27) says it may 'sell' or 'share' data via advertising cookies and pixels on its corporate website and lets ad partners collect identifiers and activity data for interest-based ads; deletion requests offered to all users regardless of location.

seo.title: Big Health: FDA-Cleared SleepioRx & DaylightRx DTx
seo.meta_description: Big Health makes Sleepio and Daylight—FDA-cleared digital therapeutics for insomnia and anxiety, often free through employer or health plan benefits.

faqs.a: Sleepio is free if your employer or health plan offers it. Major partners include CVS Health, Express Scripts, and many Fortune 500 companies. Check with HR or your insurance benefits. Sleepio isn't currently available for individual purchase.

Yes, Sleepio received FDA clearance as a prescription digital therapeutic (PDT) for chronic insomnia. It's one of few insomnia treatments with regulatory clearance. The program is based on CBT-I, the gold-standard insomnia treatment recommended by medical guidelines.

faqs.q: What is Daylight by Big Health?
faqs.a: Daylight is Big Health's FDA-cleared digital therapeutic for anxiety. It delivers CBT techniques through interactive smartphone sessions. Clinical studies show 71% of users experience meaningful anxiety reduction. Like Sleepio, access is typically through employer or health plan benefits.

faqs.q: How does Sleepio compare to Calm or Headspace?
faqs.a: Sleepio delivers structured CBT-I (cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia)—an evidence-based treatment protocol. Calm and Headspace offer relaxation content but aren't treatment programs. If you have clinical insomnia, Sleepio's therapeutic approach is more targeted than meditation apps.
